identity: Lorindor's berry woods and pearl shore pay their tolls twice: to netters in the woods at night and to mirefolk who count pearls that were never theirs.

quests.title: Nets in the Berrywoods
quests.text: Unlicensed Poachers net the {name:berrywoods} {dir_of:r20_anchor_018:berrywoods} after dark and take the birds before the berries ripen. Defeat five of them. By day the woods belong to the stags again, which is how it should be.

quests.title: The Fenhold Toll
quests.text: Toll Mirefolk at {name:fenhold} {dir_from_giver:fenhold} charge my carters a pearl for every crate, day and night. Defeat five of them. They rush to help each other, so pull from the edge of their camp.

quests.title: Highcourt Keeps Ledgers Too
quests.text: Some of the toll pearls end up in Highcourt, where Mariel Waybook keeps the human capital's road accounts. Take her my tally and see whether her outskirts have the same trouble. The road beyond Lorindor's border leads to Highcourt.

quests.title: Half-Empty Crates at Whitebridge
quests.text: Merren Oakstamp at Whitebridge Market Close buys our berries and swears the crates arrive half empty. Carry my tally to her and help her find out where the rest went. It is a long road through the human lands, so a mount would not hurt.

quests.title: The Pearl-Counter
quests.text: The fenhold pearls all go to {name:pearl_counter_iss} at the {name:pearl_camp} {dir_from_giver:pearl_camp}, who counts them twice and pays nobody. Defeat four of the camp's Toll Mirefolk and then Iss, day or night. Count to one when you are done; that is how many tolls we owe.

quests.title: Lanterns Nobody Hung
quests.text: At night, Wandering Wisps drift through the {name:elderwood} {zone_area:elderwood} and lead travellers off the path. Put out five of them. By day the wood is calm, so plan your watch for the dark hours.

quests.title: Steel for the Pale Roots
quests.text: Bring me four Steel Bars, iron alloyed with coal and smelted wherever suits you. The paleroot props in this cutting are older than the Accord, and I would like them to outlive it. The deeper seams ask for a better pick, so check yours.

quests.title: Stone Talk at Tarncut
quests.text: Kelda Screesort at Tarncut Mine in Frostbarrow Shelf props her tunnels with the same steel I use. Take her my measurements; dwarves trust numbers more than elves do, and she will have work for you. It is a long road to the dwarven heights.

quests.title: Optional: Pinchers on the Shell Strand
quests.text: Barnacle Pinchers have taken the {name:shell_strand} {dir_from_giver:shell_strand} and snap at every warden who walks it by day. Five of them will do; the strand is short and they are not. Leave the gentler Bank Crabs be.

quests.title: Optional: Pale Lights in the Paleroots
quests.text: The wisps that leave the elderwood gather in the {name:paleroots} {zone_area:paleroots}, and there they burn brighter and meaner. Put out six of them at night. The Wardenry has never found where they go by day, and would rather not.

quests.title: Optional: Bark-Strippers
quests.text: The Moss-Antler Stags of the {name:paleroots} {zone_area:paleroots} strip the bark from the pale roots faster than the trees can mend. Thin the herd by six, by day; the stags are yellow and will not start it. Stewardship is not always gentle.

quests.title: Bounty: Night Netters
quests.text: The poachers' nets come back to the {name:berrywoods} every night. Defeat six netters whenever you pass after dark, and Berrycourt will pay each time.

quests.title: Bounty: Lanterns in the Elderwood
quests.text: The wisps of the {name:elderwood} relight themselves every night. Put out six whenever you can, and the Wardenry will pay each time.

quests.title: Bounty: Steel for the Props
quests.text: Props wear out, and so do I. Bring me four Steel Bars whenever you have them, and the cutting will pay each time.
